notes:
Original and replication statistics are separately printed author-derived r values from the primary authors’ Table S1; no metric conversion performed here. Table S2 p. 20 identifies the target contrasts. Supplied replication page locator (p. 3 or p. 5) does not contain the target statistics in this supplement. No authors’ narrative verdict located; the Table S1 categorical Replicated entry is No. Original manuscript title verified (author-hosted earlier version). On pp. 17–18 it distinguishes raw mug WTA p=0.44, mug-minus-pen WTA p=0.058, and log mug-minus-log pen WTA p=0.03. The primary summary p=0.030 identifies the last test. Its generic Original N=112 is not the post-exclusion analytic n. The empty original locator and generic description are resolved using the independent primary authors’ Table S2 Experiment 2 identification.
